method: Exact-phrase web searches for each name in its usage context ('<name> cello/violin/instruments', '<name> College', 'Project <name>'); follow-up on any hit to assess same-type collision and LLM-prior plausibility. Executed 2026-08-12 by a read-only search agent (60 original names) plus orchestrator verification of the 3 replacement names. Criterion for COLLISION: a real same-type entity a frontier LLM would plausibly have priors about. Names with verdict WEAK were rotated out as a conservative measure (rotation is free pre-freeze); replacements verified infini-gram 0/0 (RedPajama+Dolma) and web-clean before adoption.
